summary: Cadeler A/S filed a Form 6-K on May 5, 2026, announcing the upcoming release of its Q1 2026 earnings on May 20, 2026. The filing is a routine earnings release notice, not a special situation. It provides the date, time, and webcast details for the earnings call, with CEO Mikkel Gleerup and CFO Peter Brogaard Hansen presenting from London. The filing includes no transaction, no terms, no board recommendation, no advisors, and no structural or regulatory mechanics. This is a standard periodic earnings notification for a foreign private issuer. No deal terms are present; the event is purely informational.
